scope: Development-only evidence for a genuine cc81 source-CAS and installed-release predecessor fixture. It does not establish source-update candidate publication, runtime/account setup, Pi acceptance, or any AC completion.

fixture.environment: Disposable Docker container, Linux ARM64, root-owned temporary filesystem; development Mac installer not run.
fixture.source_export_validation: Every exported source file matched its root-owned source manifest SHA-256, size, inode/mode metadata; Git blob SHA-1 values were recomputed and the canonical full tree reconstructed as 74dca3566f212e185cbdada7a2d401cf0d63f6e9.

publication.method: Exact public cc81 launcher, normal Linux root TTY candidate confirmation, fixed-origin source acquisition, isolated CPython 3.14 runtime, actual release builder and publisher.
publication.first_prompt: Stopped at the first existing non-root account prompt after current pointer and complete release publication; no account or runtime choice was entered.

results.historical_predecessor_positive: The new exact predecessor verifier returned VerifiedInstallerPredecessorReleaseReceipt for cc81; verify_current() passed over the complete locally built release and source CAS.
results.current_actor_separation: The ordinary current installed-release verifier continued to reject old cc81 root_setup with its reviewed current-source-pin error.
results.controlled_source_tamper: Appending to a source-CAS member caused predecessor verification to reject with candidate source changed while sealing its file custody. The modified fixture was disposable and discarded.
results.unknown_mixed_and_mode_cases: Contract tests verify exact cohort selection, mixed current/historical module-row rejection, executable-mode-sensitive Git tree reconstruction, and file/directory path collision rejection.
results.host_focused_tests: 94 passed, 13 skipped across predecessor cohort, installer release, release builder, and installed stage publisher contract suites.
results.arm64_focused_tests: 105 passed, 2 skipped for the same focused contract suites in a Linux ARM64 container with the repository source bind-mounted read-only.
results.openspec_specs: npm run validate:specs passed all 13 items.
results.planning: npm run validate:plan passed live coverage and frozen baseline checks; runtime acceptance remains not established.

limitations: The local old install did not proceed beyond the account prompt.
No candidate source-update publication, rollback, or cold recovery positive was run in this fixture.
No Pi filesystem was modified; Pi acceptance remains open.

The reviewed fixed origin is checked as current source policy; the exported CAS has no .git metadata, so runtime provenance is established through its root-owned receipt, rehashed complete tree, candidate/tree identity, and reviewed source blobs rather than querying a nonexistent Git remote.
